evidence_against: MAIN HYPOTHESIS NOT ESTABLISHED — The same supplied sources that expose no authenticated receiver also explicitly place authentication outside the advisory helpers. An unseen caller could already enforce the edge. Conversely, an unseen caller could omit it. Without a current failure, call-site trace or matched reasoning-versus-transport comparison, neither an authority-edge bottleneck nor the exclusion of model reasoning is demonstrated. Packet incompleteness must not be converted into a production root cause.

DUPLICATE INPUT-LOSS REPAIR REJECTED — Proposing the missing/unreadable-authority fail-closed change again is unsupported: the relevant distinction and route guard already exist in read_authoritative_rows/build_plan. The mission also explicitly identifies #1962 as already merged. Its autonomous adoption is unproven, but that does not justify duplicating its source change.

C2 AS A PROVEN CONSUMER BUG REJECTED — A blanket change from PASS to failure whenever an output is absent would conflate artifact publication with model completion. build_plan can legitimately require no calls when lane lists are empty or material_delta is false, and the learning-loop specification permits explicit partial products. Missing binding checks inside finalize are a real source fact, but no supplied consumer treats the resulting artifact as a validated diagnosis. A dangerous consumer remains possible, not demonstrated.

SHAPE-AS-AUTHENTICATION INFERENCE REJECTED — Adding an EXECUTED label, tightening reported actor names or treating S1_VERIFIED as authenticated would not establish a real job. validate_chain expressly returns false execution/authentication/release flags. No supplied caller is shown ignoring those flags or omitting required native checks. A new shape-only state is therefore not a substantiated autonomy repair.

S1_1946_VS_INTERACTIVE_1962 ATTRIBUTION — mission_packet.baseline describes #1946 as a bounded scheduled S1 merge and #1962 as owner-interactive. Even if those descriptions are accepted conditionally, a scheduled merge alone does not prove unattended discovery, repair, runtime adoption and natural-consumer closure. Counting both described merges as scheduled would add one erroneous scheduled credit; this is a conditional attribution calculation, not a verified performance statistic. The skill's separate #176 case is explicitly owner-invoked and says unattended effectiveness is NOT YET PROVEN.

COUNTS ARE NOT PERFORMANCE OR CAUSAL EVIDENCE — LATEST_SUPERVISOR_STATE.json reports zero orchestration lane counts, material_delta_count=0, six delegation entries and one unconsumed-information entry. Without underlying rows and eligible-case denominators, those values cannot establish no opportunities, stale-HOLD failure, successful deduplication, runtime adoption or any closure rate. The repeated UNPROVEN scientific-edge labels also provide no evidence of market-signal or economic improvement.

CONFLICTED ROUTING VOCABULARY, NOT A DEMONSTRATED ROUTING BUG — LATEST_SUPERVISOR_STATE.json::compute_policy mentions ASTRA_FOR_AGENTIC_EXTREME, whereas SOL_MAX_SHARED_MODEL_POLICY_V1.json::forbidden_auto_models/manual_astra_only and both relevant runbooks prohibit autonomous Astra selection. evidence_for: GOAL DEPENDENCY GRAPH — VERIFIED as a documented specification, UNKNOWN as execution. 00_FMOS/CHAT_S1_ELITE_RUNBOOK.md §§1–5 specifies: current task/authority/source and original-owner discovery -> source/head-bound causal diagnosis -> authorized original-branch repair with one writer -> exact-head substantive PR-event CI plus binding reviews/rules -> native merge with expected_head_sha -> new-main/changed-blob readback -> separate natural-consumer observation. Source, authority, review and recovery are prerequisites, not consequences of model output. The supplied planner and receipt verifier are separate advisory implementations; no supplied call graph connects them to each other or to the named scheduled task.

G0–G4 LABEL DISAGREEMENT — VERIFIED textual difference. The mission uses G0 discovery, G1 diagnosis, G2 repair, G3 release and G4 main/consumer. Runbook §7 instead defines G0 code/main proof; G1 native REQUEST -> ACK/ACCEPT -> authenticated job EXECUTED -> RESULT -> consumed ACK; G2 saved-task runtime adoption; G3 original disposition/main/consumer; and G4 actual seven-/28-day net impact. Immediate consumer readback must not silently substitute for the runbook's measured G4 impact. Neither complete evidence set is supplied.

EXISTING INPUT-LOSS GUARD — VERIFIED source behavior. scripts/framework_intelligence/automation_orchestration_v1.py::read_authoritative_rows distinguishes UNAVAILABLE/INVALID authority from an explicit list-valued owner snapshot. build_plan sets authority_unknown when either owner view is not VALID; after preserving a matched active remediation route, unmatched items take AUTHORITATIVE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE with model_lane=NONE. This is a concrete guard already present in the supplied source, although its linkage to PR #1962 is not independently authenticated.

PLANNING IS NOT EXECUTION — VERIFIED source behavior. automation_orchestration_v1.py::build_plan constructs advisory routes, contexts and agent_calls flags; it does not implement a provider call, authenticated receiver execution, branch repair or merge. Its fingerprint_basis omits refreshed observation timestamps but includes latest_run_id, latest_head_sha, findings, route, remediation state and authority status. Thus a timestamp refresh alone is not a new diagnostic opportunity, while a new recorded native run can change the fingerprint even at unchanged HEAD. Runtime use of these protections remains UNKNOWN.

HANDOFF VERIFIER BOUNDARY — VERIFIED source behavior. scripts/governance/s1_agent_handoff_receipts_v1.py::validate_chain checks reported binding consistency, ordered states/times, actor labels and URL shapes. STEPS contains REQUESTED, ACKNOWLEDGED, ACCEPTED, RESULT_DELIVERED and S1_VERIFIED, not an authenticated execution event. The return values explicitly set authenticated_delivery=False, actual_job_execution_proven=False and release_authorized=False. A terminal S1_VERIFIED can also report verification=BLOCKED. handoff_followup contains optional expected_source_head and expected_request_binding_sha256 fences, ACK-anchored result timing and no-duplicate-request guidance. Authentication and replay-ledger checks are explicitly delegated to a native caller.

C2 FINALIZE: BOTH-WAYS ADJUDICATION — VERIFIED source behavior; SUPPORTED artifact-publication interpretation; UNKNOWN consumer safety. automation_orchestration_v1.py::finalize checks the plan contract, reads optional outputs with read_json(..., None), copies them into luna_triage and sol_6_1_diagnosis, and writes LATEST_AGENT_READOUT.json. It does not compare an output fingerprint, validate its contract or require output for an eligible lane. main prints status=PASS after finalize returns successfully. Missing/unreadable output therefore becomes null, and other parseable JSON is retained without demonstrated binding. However, the emitted object remains ADVISORY_ORCHESTRATION_ONLY and says outputs are evidence/diagnosis only; the source does not equate CLI PASS with authenticated execution or accepted scientific evidence.

STRATEGIST/OWNER ROUTING — VERIFIED recorded fields, not native delivery. research/framework_learning/LATEST_SUPERVISOR_STATE.json records automatic_routing=false, automatic_model_calls=false, master_monday_live_influence=false and canonical_effect=false, with proposal identifiers and a Strategist digest/reference. 00_FMOS/CHAT_S1_ELITE_RUNBOOK.md §6 documents external method -> #1512 -> advisory #1157 -> existing domain original -> #1156 qualified implementation. 00_FMOS/FRAMEWORK_INTELLIGENCE_AND_LEARNING_LOOP_v1.md requires references to existing owners and preserves missing authoritative inputs. These are routing constraints and metadata, not proof of an ACK, executed job or consumed result.

ONE-CASE/FOUR-MATERIAL-TOUCH CONTRACT — VERIFIED documented contract. Runbook §§3–5 specifies one deep causal case at a time, at most three distinct active originals, and no duplicate editor. Only novel material diagnosis, repair, hosted validation or terminal disposition increments a touch; idle wakes, repeated fingerprints, skipped CI and another actor's action do not. By at most four real treatments, disposition must be a verified merge/safe supersession or a specific external/internal terminal state with an objective trigger. SLA_BREACHED requires more than four proven material treatments without qualified disposition; an original is not closed merely for expiry. The packet contains no receipts with which to score compliance.

RELEASE/CONSUMER/ROLLBACK SEPARATION — VERIFIED documented contract. Runbook §3 and .agents/skills/s1-pr-repair-learning/SKILL.md::D separate changed branch bytes, native original-PR merge/main proof and independent natural defect closure. Required PR-event jobs that are skipped or execute zero tests do not qualify; a build or synthetic dispatch is not natural-consumer proof. The runbook requires previous-main revert planning and changed-blob readback. None of these documentary requirements itself establishes a completed release or grants this analysis execution authority.
